lockup.title: Amazon Prime Video
lockup.subtitle: Originals, movies, TV, sports
lockup.editorialTagline: Butcher wages war on the Supes
lockup.editorialDescription: Convinced you’ve run out of things to watch? Amazon Prime Video may be able to prove otherwise. The app is brimming with brilliant films, dramas, and comedies, as well as sports and children’s TV, all available to watch on demand. We love the ultra-high-quality 4K streaming and the slick UI. Oh, and the ability to create multiple user profiles and download series to watch later. There are also hundreds of Amazon Originals to check out—great series and films produced by Amazon Studios that you won’t find anywhere else.

items.title: Paramount+
items.subtitle: Originals, Movies and Sports
items.editorialDescription: Fans of critically acclaimed CBS series like The Good Fight, NCIS, The Stand, and The Late Show With Stephen Colbert will love Paramount+. Sports fans can stream the NCAA tournament, the UEFA Champions League, the NFL on CBS, and the Masters. Newshounds can tune in to 60 Minutes and CBS Evening News. Star Trek series past, present, and future are establishing their home base here too. And there’s loads to watch with kids, including Dora the Explorer, Paw Patrol, Blue’s Clues, and the best of Nickelodeon’s streaming catalog.

items.title: Marvel Unlimited
items.subtitle: Read 30K Marvel Digital Comics
items.editorialDescription: Marvel Unlimited’s tagline is “Never stop reading comics.” And given the sheer amount of content in there, that’s entirely possible. It’s pretty tough to overstate the amount of content in Marvel Unlimited. New titles turn up every week, sometimes as soon as six months after they hit stores. That means fresh issues of Asgardians of the Galaxy, Runaways, and Immortal Hulk.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Read Marvel faves from The Avengers to Star Wars with a single subscription.

items.title: PBS KIDS Video
items.subtitle: Stream shows, movies & songs
items.editorialDescription: Arthur, Curious George, Sesame Street, and many more beloved family-friendly shows are available on demand with PBS Kids Video. This platform offers an ever-expanding library of content that’s regularly updated. The best part? All of it is available for free, without the need for a subscription.

items.title: Endel: Focus & Sleep Sounds
items.subtitle: ADHD Productivity Timer
items.editorialDescription: Many apps deliver soothing sounds to help you to relax, focus, or sleep. But Endel is one of the few with an algorithm smart enough to customize soundscapes for you in the moment. Sometimes it’s the sounds of the ocean, calming rain, or spherical sounds, all paired with harmonic tone sequences.
